text: Early days, so far seems fine, very standard, but different items to usual. It correctly says no ads, but I wouldn't mind the option of ads to get more energy. There is no way to restore energy and keep playing except spend gems, which run out almost instantly, which means spend real money, which I never do. So I fear I will lose interest quickly.

Fun to begin with, but takes far too much energy to complete orders. I can go days trying to merge the product I need, spending all my energy, and still not reach it. Getting really fed up and the new update has made it even harder. Additionally, there's no freebie (usually you can get 1 thing per day in these games) and to buy 100 energy costs 20 rubies instead of the usual 10.

this is my favourite phone game :) it's enjoyable and interesting. the animations are lovely. only criticism/feedback I have is that I wish it wouldn't force pop ups of every event every time I open the app (daily quest list, a notification of the bingo, the doughnut race, ball dispenser, double point special, sugar river, new sale event, etc...), especially when I log in more than twice a day - it's a bit overkill. Outside of that, I love this game!

I really love this game and find it easy, can understand other people's frustrations with the amount of energy needed to get to the final item needed though and the length of time it takes. I have just got a new phone and annoyingly when I've downloaded the app on my new phone it has lost all of my progress. Is there a way of being able to recover it?

this used to be my favourite merge game and I didn't mind spending money on it when I was having fun with it. but after the new update it's far too hard to get the orders needed. I play my 100 energy's within minutes and then have to turn it off as I cant even fulfill 1 order. Don't think I will continue anymore.

Items drop up to three types of things which you then need to merge to complete the tasks. But at least one of those types seems to have an exceptionally low drop rate yet most tasks want them at a high level. You can spend all your energy tapping the item and not a single one will drop. Its such a waste of time and so frustrating. I certainly wouldn't put any money towards this game. Also, you collect coins but you barely need any to upgrade the buildings. So they are pointless!

I love this game. I've been playing it for a while. As merge games go this is one of my favourites. There are NO ADS unless you want a booster or pop a bubble. Although, as you get further in the game, you get fewer and fewer chances to pop Bubbles for free. Another downside is the side games. They want high value items, so you end up spending all your energy very quickly and goals get more difficult. I have never completed a bonus game yet. Other than that......Really good 👍

eta still playing since 08/24, just want 2 say thanks 4 latest update 💖 steady game, no annoying ads, what I love most is that they keep bringing new items to merge, not the same old boring ones on and on, don't mind spending some occasional real money on some extra energy and support the devs, but even that recharges up at a reasonable pace and if you play it right, you can get some lucky streaks, one big downside though, it's addictive! 😁 hard to put down , great job devs! 👍👍

I did find the game fun but I can't get over the use of ai in the art. The photo album event, it's the most obvious with all the pictures looking very unnatural, especially the lighting and perspective. Also the most recent loading screen for Easter is the ugliest thing I've ever seen. Doesn't even look like the same characters. It's either ai completely messing it up, or a new artist who doesn't follow what the characters are meant to look like. Terrible ai art makes your studio look horrible.

How come your enjoying a game then they do a update and make the game harder and harder after every update. It's like come and play the game then oh that's a bit easy we will have to make it harder so they have to spend money. I remember buying whole games for a tenner now they want you to spend hundreds trying to complete a game. World's gone mad.

level 121... An enjoyable game but it's a clear money grab. I just spent 350 energy to get a pencil case and still didn't get the 1 medal needed. This will be the reason I delete the game. Developers obviously want you to buy energy qbut even so what's the point when you need more than 500 energy for a level 2 or 3 item

Used to be my favorite merge game, but recently I've found the "randomization" of items spawned by generators to be quite scam-y. It's not normal having to use 300+ energy to get ONE level 2 item...... it's making me feel like they just want me to spend money for more energy and it's just so scammy. I won't be playing again until they fix this, even tho I am now at level 168 and have actually spent money on this game before.

currently at 170... the game is addictive...I have spent real money on this game, but even when you get some of these packages. it is still a struggle to complete tasks because it's always stuff that takes the longest to merge. so you keep on spending but show no progress. also noticed that if you have a lot of energy itwon't generate the ones you want so that your energy goes by faster. so again,y,u keep on spending. before when a new item comes out, you get an energy box. Now you no longer do.

I like the story. But I wish you focused on one area at a time. And then unlocked the next one. As for the merging. Well what annoys me is the fact I have to keep building things up (the chairs with the umbrella) to get the stuff from that. If things could just be permanent I honestly think it would go better. And the rates different things drop. I can get a ton of bath stuff before getting any of the other. And same with others having two/three different items is also annoying.

I do enjoy this game, but as others have said, the amount of time it takes to merge certain items can be so long that it's takes the enjoyment out. Also, the olive bucket takes 6 taps of energy each time to get one item, which just gobbles up your energy so fast. It's so infuriating. I actually dread getting an"order" for it on this game. If there is one thing to change, please get rid of this as it just feels like a con to get money.

I feel disappointed with this game now. I've been playing it for years, it's been one of my favourites, but lately it's changed. It's no longer rewarding. It takes forever to merge enough items to reach goals. You can easily use all of your 100 bolts without receiving anything to use in the mini games. You very rarely collect any diamonds. There's just no point playing.

Could be a great game. I have been enjoying it but takes too long to merge everything and starting to go off the game sadly due to this. Some items have several different mergable items under 1 object, and then once you finally get the item such as the shaker, it only has a certain amount of use then you have to start all over again. It's SO TEDIOUS. It takes so long to fulfil orders and the board is too small for the amount of items you have. A big shame because I loved the story line.

I loved this game and have spent money on it. But I'm done. I'm at a point where I've just spent another £5.99 and literally completed about 2 orders with an 820 energy level. Don't waste your money or your time. They've made it impossible to progress unless you're willing to spend an absolute fortune on the game or wait days to fill one order. I'm unistalling. I get that they want money but have some balance at the very least.

I enjoy the game. I've had it about a week or two now and it's been good. However, as others have said, certain things you need are really hard to get and when you do they only have certain amount of use. The olive pot is horrible and of course it isn't just olives that come out of it. Think this game needs another playable aspect to earn the energy needed. Match 3 perhaps or something similar. Or maybe let the energy regenerate quicker. Takes over 3 hours to get a full set of energy.

You know I really do love this merge game. I'm invested in the story, I love the characters and I love the different things you can merge throughout the game. However as I have progressed (I'm on level 172!) it's become too hard to play! You can't merge required items with your energy and you're not earning enough to continue the plot. You can't take advantage of the events because all customers want high merge stuff. I've spent an embarrassing amount and yet at this point I only have regrets.

I agree with the majority of players this is a good game I love playing it but energy for one item requires too much. No ads with this game is great. Nobody wants ads. I've reached left 30 almost at 31 and can't progress further as it's not generating building materials been stuck for days now. Thinking of deleting. Pity really as it's a good game. I won't purchase anything games should be free to play. And fun to play. You shouldn't have to spend real money. And I refuse to anyway.

The gameplay itself is fine, typical stuff. the issue is actually being able to just play it, first you have to shut down all the advertisements to buy, buy, buy more energy or gems etc. then you are forced through the intros to the daily side quests. sure there's a little 'X' to leave but pressing it just continues it onwards making it pointless. it's so frustrating, like pop up ads, ALL the time.

This is one of the very many merge games out there. Even though it looks great and is slickly presented, it quickly becomes clear what a money grab it is. I guess there is always a price to pay for the "no ads" model. Orders become hard to meet quite early. Frustratingly, their generators time out or disappear in no time at all. The game keeps throwing extra energy at you to keep you playing, yet it's hard to make progress. It's a time sink but not in a good way *Awaits AI bot response to this*

Pros: great story line, good enough graphics, has opportunities to get free energy and gems by playing the game. Good game concept but overall it is an energy grab. Items require too much energy and too many items require more than 200 energy to create. Although it is being advertised as agame where real money is not required, it is a cash grab because there are constant pop ups to purchase packages and there is a need to spend real cash if you want to speed up the process of creating an item.

Even though the ad raves about it being the exact game in the adverts with over 10000 levels, and you get, $100 worth of stuff, blah blah it's all bull! As I suspected. It's not the game in the ads and has 551 levels. It's one of those games where devs buy assets and chuck it together so there's a few games on the app store exactly the same as this, just with a different skin. there are no ads, that's true, but the purpose of the game is to get you to spend real money on pretend health.

very good time killer, a game that has so much to progress through that it'll stay installed on your phone for over a year. no ads and I have actually bought a few bundles a few times. my only complaint is the pop ups about events, events ending, shop popups or how long these animations lock you out of doing things. if this can be tuned or toned down, then loading the game up would be so much quicker.

This is a strategy game.. it's okay to play and quit addictive as well. but be aware that you will not get incentive what you hoped for (if you don't spend money which is £10 to £2 ). I have played it many times and after spending £10 ..I didn't get items or life. I spend 30 James and I got only 130 life's max.. this game is rigged for you to spend money.. there is no free fun .. so enter with your risk. Don't hope for much. Thanks to the creators.. congrtulons you did find a way to make money.

After seeing endless advertising for this game stating that it is absolutely free to play, I downloaded the game only to find that by level 7 you need to purchase gems to continue the game!! So much for being free!! Also, the adverts are very misogynistic!! And way too many of them, so it's obvious the developers are trying clueless on how to attract potential players. Advertise less and make sure your adverts are true... stop lying on your adverts... and then you might attract more players!!!

Good to start with, but the money grab is just too high with this game... you would have to spend £50/$80+ to outright get some of the higher items based on gem costs. If your not paying? It's not even a game... open, click on single item for 60 seconds, then close game for 3 hours. I quote happily spend money in games, but this takes it waaaay to far!

Really enjoyoing the game. Love the way the levels advance and that there are no ads. But energy takes way too long to recover, considering it is used up so easily. Recovering energy is capped at 100, which I understand, but it's unfair that you can't recover any energy if you already have more than 100 poeces after purchasing or winning it. It feels like you're penalised for having too much of it. I can't justify spending a lot on this game, but feel like you can't play if you don't.

Please stop forcing us purchase items. Everytime you click to build the houses it tells you to purchase something. Another thing is the energy is insufficient! You only get 100 every three hours which isn't enough to complete ONE order. I feel like the game also needs a community where you can talk to other players, that would be super cool. It's a fun game but the ads and energy is making it less fun to play day by day. Also it is HARD TO ACQUIRE SUPPLIES TO BUILD THE HOUSES, RATHER IMPOSSIBLE

The game is great and super creative however there's this inconvenience that's stopping me from getting really into the game. It's a struggle to get energies in order to fulfill the missions or orders. If we could at least find a way to get more energy or fulfil the orders would make the game more amusing. I've spent most of my gems to buy the energy. The game is great but I feel like I'm at impass. I've read comments complaining about the same thing. I really hope you look into this. 😔

I downloaded this hoping to get what the ad videos show - a destitute woman needing help to rebuild her home etc. What a disappointment!!! 😞 It's just like all the other merge and build games, you don't get to "Choose the next level" as shown in the add. Instead you have fill customer orders which have absolutely nothing to do with helping the woman rebuild 👎👎👎

Only played for a few days - I imagine it might get better at some point when more items become available but it was just too boring. Plus side - no glitches or ads, hence 3 stars. Given how little progress I made though with the amount of free gems given, it seems inevitable that I'd need to spend real money to get anywhere with it. So I've deleted it.

Your ad states this game has no ads, is completely free and also promised $100 of in-game content for downloading the game through the ad. There really are no ads, which is nice. But the game is certainly not free and the promised free content wasn't received. Just like all the other games of this type, your energy runs out fast, yet takes a very long time to fill back up. As usual, it's engineered to get people to spend real money and I'm simply fed up of games made by greedy people!

Introduced through another app. Was really enjoying it until it became impossible to progress without spending money on in app purchases. It's extremely frustrating. If you aren't going to allow a half decent free play then at least give alternate ways of earning what is needed. I'd rather watch ads than do this. I've bought and paid for things already and I've spent what I believe the game would have been worth to buy. I won't spend anymore so it's a shame I'll likely delete it now.

Let me start off by saying it really is a waste of time playing this game because when you reach higher levels, you really play for about 3 to 5 minutes tops, and then all your energy is used up regarding all the endless merging just to make one item. So, in order to continue playing, you either have to wait the 2 hours for your energy to refill or pay money to buy more energy. And it's stupid to buy more energy just for another 5 minutes of actual game play, and I'm not exaggerating.

I loved this game until they introduced item generator that needs 6 clicks/energy to get 1 item (and there are 2 different item trees for it). Since then, it's become soul destroying. It's a shame because the story is fun and the dialogue is well written. Progress's been stalled to get people to spend cash to get more energy. I get it, they want a profit, but I don't think this is the right way! Removed 1* due to pointless, templated dev response! No response better than this thoughtless drivel.

I see the game developers are stepping up the lying adverts. It's a merge game. There aren't 10,000 levels, the gameplay isn't like the ad. I'm not actually sure how they get away with it. The cheek is astounding, to have ads all about how the other games are lying but this one actually has the advertised gameplay, when not only does this one not have it but many other lying ads are from the same game developers.

I've been playing this for a while now and it quickly became a favourite, however the further you progress the more impossible it becomes without spending money. Energy takes too long to recover and items take more energy than you can get in that recovery period. I've spent money because I enjoy it, but you also keep increasing the prices of packages etc which is really unfair. It's a shame because the game itself is worth more than 2 stars, but you need to make changes to make it more playable.

Not the game in the adverts, when a game flashes up multiple choices of spending your hard earned cash to progress you should delete it. I have enjoyed playing this game - but have wasted a huge amount of money. Far to many moves to create anything. Strangely as I start to think just delete it, I seem to earn a lot of moves etc and get sucked back in and then soon back to 3 minutes of game time before you need to pay to advance.

This game is fun, the visuals and the story are amazing, however the pop ups are a nightmare. To even open the app you have automatic popups for every possible event that you can't click out of and need to participate in. Then there's the pass, then there's the bingo, then there's the any other event and the star. I understand you want players to know but the fact it forcefully redirects players and takes up the entire screen is ridiculous. It takes five minutes just to play. Please please help!

I initially loved the game but im getting increasingly peeved at it, the game gives you exactly what you don't need, for example flowers if you need photos and vice versa. Generators give secondary items freely when you don't have an order for them, but when you do have an order you can spend hundreds of energy and still not fulfil it. I get that it's a free game but some of us are buying energy with real money to get absolutely nowhere with an order.

Lies lies lies, and a massive Money Grab! When I downloaded this game it was from an advert that offered $100 off free y items for the game. Lies!! No freebies. Started to play anyway and after 30 minutes in game I come to the first issue, in order to progress you need energy, in order to get energy you work l either have to wait for hours or buy it! The mechanics of the merge section of the game mean you will only get the drops you need AFTER purchasing more energy. Rip off, uninstalling.

Only play if you want to spend a lot of money! This game launches competitions every day and very few last for more than 24 hours so unless you spend money to buy energy you NEVER finish them. The rewards are some of the most miserly I've ever received. There is no new input from Seaside Escape they just redo the same old. one competition you collects shells, the next you make chocolates but the format behind the game is exactly the same, just different pictures. Not value at all. Don't bother.

I do absolutely love this game. But it's takes so long to complete orders that it can become not fun. It's great that you win energy but the time it takes to regenerate each category is annoying. Unless you spend real money all the time to get gems. The regenerating should not exist and instead only have to stop playing when you run out of energy. If this was fixed I would enjoy playing so much more.

This game is all about getting you to spend money...the entertainment value is pretty low since everything is geared towards you spending your own cash and getting nothing in return... ...I wouldn't recommend this app given that you have to spend lots of money to succeed...the idea behind the game is ok I suppose however the experience is rubbish...since you have to pay to succeed in the game... ... Buy a join the dots book...it will cost less and be more entertaining

Meh. It's a merge game with no intrusive ads which is a plus. The storyline so far is extremely heavy on making the the MC feel guilty. The way gems are earned is different to most games I've played but I see at some point there will be a slowing to collecting them. I achieved level 6 but finally quit and uninstalled it. I did not enjoy this game. I actually started to get angry on the MC's behalf and disliked the NPC she was interacting with. It was like a broken record with the guilt.

3.5 🌟 Seaside Escape is a fun and charming game, but a few issues dampen the experience. The biggest frustration is the energy system—waiting for energy to refill, disrupting gameplay, and slow progress. Additionally, the board often gets cluttered with items that aren’t in play, making puzzles harder than necessary. Despite these drawbacks, the game has plenty of positives. The seaside theme is beautifully designed and creates a relaxing, immersive experience.

Great game. Plenty going on. New items to keep things interesting. Nice and slick game board too. Energy runs out too quickly though, but that's the same with most games. So lovely though, not to have annoying ads every couple of minutes. Great graphics and plenty of help on the way through. I'm playing the Mansion game too but it's so slow and sticky, so now I much prefer this one.

Had to experience a constant barrage of ads whilst playing other games that sells Seaside Escape as a game where you actually help a woman basically not die by fixing a window or whatever, making her home liveable. So I finally downloaded it, only to find it's just a carbon copy of all the other merge games and indeed doesn't have the helpless woman in it. False advertisement. Boring. Sucks.

The game has started out fun and relaxing but has now become frustrating and pointless. I have made it to kevel 171, but the orders that need to be filled to advance are ridiculous. Most of the items needed are 6-10 layers deep, and the algorithms used to award the pieces seem to be stacked against what is needed to fill the orders. It will take days (or a lot of money) to fill even 1 order. Too much effort for little reward.

It used to be fun, but level 150+ is just awful. It's taking Upto 2 days to complete half an order. The wedding cake only seems to give flowers,never photos, I've used over 200 energy and I've got 2 photos, the stamps are stupid, 1 stamp and it takes best part of 100 energy to get that, yet the booklet requires at least around 10 stamps.. it's getting to the point I'll uninstall. The feedback I've read from everyone else is the same. Will the Devs ever deal with the issue? Doubtful.

i really enjoy the storyline and like the characters, and enjoy most of the gameplay, especially the fact that we continually get new items to merge so it never gets too repetitive. my issues are that some of the items are really difficult to get (i.e. microphones, brochures), meaning some orders take forever to complete, and there's no way to replenish energy except for gems (which run out way too fast) and nothing to spend coins on (i have like 600k - why cant i spend this on energy??)

This game is moderately fun. It would be a LOT of fun, but the constant barrage of pop-up ads trying to get you to make in-app purchases make it virtually unplayable. This app boasts about not having ads in the game, and while that is technically true they more than make up for it with the relentless stream of promotions for paid credits. It's so aggressive that 1/2 the time I close the app before I even play because 2 minutes into closing windows I've lost interest. Total bummer.

This game is really good, love the storyline and no pop up ads which is really good. Could we have more customers at a time please. I only ha e 4 customers and they all want thknva that take forever to get out of things It eould be nice to have more that I could use my energy on. Also using 6 energy to get something out of the decorated pot? That is way too much. Apart from those things this game is great. Really clean clear graphics just like in Gossip Harbour. 🙂

Good game. Too many time outs when playing though. Have to keep using Gems and they run out quick. No where near to be able to complete orders. As you run out of energy and gems and have NO other way to get any unless you Pay actual money which slightly annoys me. It would be nice if you could use the coins you collect to get some Gems or energy instead of having to either spend loads of money or wait hours. This game is great if you have 100s of pounds to spend so you can actually play it.

This games is great ... For the few minutes at a time you can play.... It's great that there are no ads however its almost impossible /too time consuming so can quickly lose interest in progressing through the game more because of how long it's takes to build energy back up ,or items to recharge. The board gets clogged quickly so you have to delete items /energy is quickly wasted trying to get one thing Ie. Sunbedd will come out in there dozens but can take forever to get whistles

The actual game wasn't too bad but I was promised 100 dollars in in game stuff for downloading it from an ad, which I did and got nothing. Played until level 7-8 and was bombarded with purchases you could make. Never mind it was nothing like the ads (where you merge to help a family) and the ads themselves were annoying as hell and took like a whole two minutes to get though. If I could give it a zero for being misleading and having annoying ads I would.

very nice. very addicting. one of the few games i'm very tempted to spend money on. although you dont have to, to enjoy the game. only feedback i guess is the lack of things to spend coins on. i currently have abou 1 million of them and you only need usually a few thousand to progress the story. suggest maybe to allow conversion to something else like 50k for gem or for other resources. edit: after launching app, it loads really slowly unlike merge harbor and flambe

this game is ok, but it quickly becomes unplayable due to the sheer number of matches required to achieve the desired item. energy replenishes too slowly. and the rewards for completing items too low. there are no ads, though, so that gives it the extra star. I've uninstalled it and do not recommend.

It's a lot of fun and it's actually very easy to earn coins, energy and building materials. But this means that your board becomes very full very quickly. It's not quite as easy to earn gems either, which you can use to buy more spaces in the inventory, but it's not hugely difficult. One bad thing is that above a certain level or with certain rarer props you automatically generate bubbles containing items which, once again, take up a ton of space on the board. Still fun though!

Game is very satisfying and has a fun story, but too many generators are available at once without being able to store more. New resource generators should either open more slowly, or space for old ones should open up sooner. It would also be nice if there was an alert that I won’t need a generator anymore; as is I keep all the pieces around not knowing if I'll need them. My storage is used up just with generators and high-leveled items i may or may not need.

FIX THE DANG COINS!!! WHY have coins if there's no use for them? I have over ONE MILLION COINS, and can't use them for anything game related (Or non-game related). Your game uses ENERGY too quickly, but doesn't regenerate nearly fast enough. I strongly advise changing the coins for using to "purchase" more energy.

Playing for almost a year. The game is fun but however it does take you to have to pay to play to beat those events. and after playing this long. 100 energy is over ridiculous once you level up so far but asking us to pay money for energy. the energy you give us is not enough to complete orders or building materials. sad that you have to come out of actual money every and I mean every event. I have never completed one and know I never will it's sad

been playing this gae for 2+ years and I love it. But the recent update is really making me consider uninstalling it because it takes 10 times longer to get items to complete and order. it takes me days even a week at time to finish one task. Im going to playing for a few more days and make my decision. I will be sad to do so because I spent years and money on this game. It's just not fun anymore.

Dynamic Pricing in an app?! Seriously? I decided to purchase some of the extra features in the app, but tell me why when I first made purchases things were 2.99- 4.99, but now its literally 14.99 for that same package? Ruined my love for this brain numbing game. Update 7/1/2026- Now the game is glitching. I give up. Uninstalled.

The game is relaxing and a good way to kill time, at least for a few minutes. Once you reach higher levels, game progression slows significantly as orders require more items to merge and you burn through energy quickly. Unless you want to pay money, it's difficult to complete events before time runs out as you're stuck waiting for your energy to refill. It would be nice if you could increase max energy as you level up, I think it would make the game more enjoyable in the long run.

Fun, well designed game. Story is interesting enough to not be a chore to slog through to get back to more matching. Game heavily encourages purchases, which I have done on occasion. The dispensing devices for matching pieces are not random. The game heavily alters what pieces you get to avoid items you need to progress in game. Unattractive way to try to force purchases when energy is being wasted all day on junk.

Fun game but can't play more than 5 mins max a time after passing the first levela. It gets harder as you level up so there's no satisfaction of leveling and things getting easier. To continue playing you'd have to be spending upwards of 10$ per day, which is insane. I don't need all the extra side games this developer keeps producing. Would rather they simplify it, less flashy, and make it more affordable and longer play time. Ad in optional ads to get energy or something. No longer fun. :(

The latest update to the items produced is terrible! Now it takes MUCH longer to get the items needed for orders. Especially from the wedding shop and the orangery. I used up all 100 plays and I'm not even halfway to getting any orders filled. The progress of this game is already painfully slow due to the sheer number of construction items. Now it's virtually unplayable. Please restore the wedding shop and orangery to what it was before the update.

I used to love this game, I re-installed it to play again but they've changed the way you build to level up and it's now more difficult. I have over a million gold/coins, but not even *close* to the amount of building materials. I wish there was an easier way to get them, especially since there are only a certain amount of orders you can complete where you get any to begin with. I am not going to spend money to get the gems for these boxes, that's unrealistic... I'm very sad.

Really liked at first, now close to deleting. Decided to spend some money to test whether winning any of the contest were possible and after that, could not win!!! In addition building gets harder and the story is dragging on very slowly. Also the music is very annoying but I turn the sound down. I really think I will be deleting unless they make this more enjoyable. Also I don't mind spending a few bucks here and there for items in a game you can keep but this game isn't like that.

decent match game with a story line. one of the mechanics is annoying in that it has you retire some of the game objects when they will no longer be used, but then will have an event that uses them. by that time you already have so many other newer things on the board, it isn't worth pulling those back out. some of the pop ups can be annoying but over all a decent game

As others have said, the pop-ups urging you to spend money are annoying. My biggest complaint is energy. Max energy is 100, and once you're past level 10 or so, most orders will cost over 100 energy to fill. And then the barrage of "Give us money to keep playing!" starts all over again. Lots of identical games out there that aren't quite so greedy and unplayable.

I used to love this game but the update made it so much more time consuming in a not fun way we cant even make it half way with spending all my energy and its just boring, the previous version was fun where you add stuff together and you get items out of a maxed item but this is just trash, I used to spend hours on here but playing it now? I think I will just delete it bwcuase its so disappointing everytime I play.

Love this game. One of the top merge fames I've played. Regular tasks are obtainable. The special tasks are as well but the rewards aren't really worth the items you must collect. Has fun and colorful side games. Only negative is you can only obtain 100 energy max. Other games will continue to add energy over the hours.

It's a good game for timepass. Unlike other similar games, they will provide you with dimonds and energy. But the problem is that when you level up, the higher level producers take hours to recharge. It WAS fun at first The game tanks once you get to the higher levels. The energy you need to fulfill orders is impossible. Actually, it's a good game. However, there's something that makes me feel really unhappy every time I play it. I don't know how this game has a 4.4 rating. the concept of the game is fun but it's just another false advertisement money trap. it's not the game advertised in all those ads you get on other games. It started out fun, but as your progress it ends up costing like 100 energy to produce 1 item. Which is more frustrating than fun. INFLATION SHOULDN'T EXIST IN A GAME.

The game was fun and all at first, very interesting lines and story, I have been playing it for a good while. One thing that distroyed that fun is THE Energy SYSTEM. in the beginning this game was great. as I've progressed I've found that progression is nearly impossible without spending $ on the game. to fulfill one "order" or whatever I've played for two days, every time my energy regular and STILL have not gotten the item I need. and I have spent A LOT of $ on this game and have played it every day for months. but at this point I'm about to give up bc it has become freaking nearly impossible. and it makes me SO sad bc I love it. ur losing a good customer

If you wish to get frustrated, please download. It's super hard to complete the orders when the items for merging are not appearing! It's useless to have a lot of energy where the board is full! The purpose we want to play game is to enjoy not making life harder.

Saw an ad about a block pushing game. That is NOT what the game is about. Great game, immediately got addicted. I skip through the story and enjoy the matching aspect, however I have over 1m coins Which I can't use for anything. I love this game! One problem is I paid for a bonus then all of a sudden it is trying to make me pay again. I don't mind purchasing from time to time, but I would like it to deliver as promised. Second it is beginning to really drag out too much. Getting from the next moment to the next is getting too drawn out. Except for these glitches it would be a 5!

What is a total turnoff? Your long ads in other games. Some are so bad it seems like 20 minutes go by...obviously not that long but probably a minute or two [will have to time them]. False advertising. So after watching many adverts of this game, I finally gave in, just to be very disappointed. This app uses a large amount of storage, needlessly. You can clear the cache and stored data (nearly 3 gig the other day) and the game is still playable. Very fun game at the beginning, until 35 lvl, but after it is very hard to complete tasks, u don't get the items needed. It is getting frustrating using 1000 energies and not been able to complete 1 task. LE:"a little bit later". Going fast forward, I'm at level 198 and is getting more and more annoying. U spend more and receive less. It is time for another game. Uninstall!

The game is an average merge game. I play several merge games by the same company and I treat them more as a time waster than to seriously progress. In game popups are annoying, and if you don't spend money, you'll never seriously go anywhere. It's ok as a time filler, but don't expect to be able to play beyond a few minutes before needing to spend. My biggest grievance is the lying deceptive ads for the game. If you see it advertised anywhere, the actual gameplay is NOTHING like the ads show.

When you advertise a game, make sure it's realistic to actual game play. I kept seeing ads for this game, so I downloaded it. It's NOTHING like how it was advertised. You say you get $100 worth of gems, coins, energy, and so on, but I didn't see anything like that. Advertised as "you'll delete all other games," itnot true. I'm deleting this game.

Okay. Firstly, don't ever think the game will be like what the ads show. It's NOWHERE NEAR THE ADS. But, secondly, it's fun to play and really enjoyable without paying a dime. I even succeeded finishing the scrapbook events without paying for extra gems and/or energy bolts. Well, I still buy in-game perks every once in a while (more like once every other month, I think) but it's not required to fully enjoy the game at all. Good job, microfun!

The game can feel quite tedious. I enjoy merging the items, but I do not enjoy having to build another source item (that includes a lot of steps) only to get a few items out of it before you have to build the source item all over again. Pair it with incredulously low rate for the "rare" items, and it becomes quite a chore of click, click, merge, click, click, merge, ... Great game, sad you have to bleed money to play it. The game is quite engaging and fun to play. The down side is you have to pay money to play it. The very minimal free perks, coins and gems are very limited and definitely don't compensate for the amount you have to pay to then play the game effectively. I can see why people download it and then uninstall it rather quick. Definitely not living up to it's full potential. Most wouldn't pay to play this.

I downloaded the game because I saw the ad with the tile sliding game. While that does exist in this game, it's very minimal. There are 30 of those levels total, 3 of which are tutorials. About half the levels you need to play a match-two game to unlock. The match-two game is the main gameplay. If you want that, the game is probably fine, I dunno. I don't understand why companies always advertise their games as completely different than what they really are.

should i keep playing? it was fun, but lately it's getting more and more difficult to complete just 1 order. frustraring huh? the order is mostly consists of 2 items and each of them is a high level item (lv. 10+)that need 200+ energy and the other is what you need to produce from the combination of 2 other generator items, that might or might not be produce as they are random generated items. this alone will, too, takes more than 200energy. seems like you sabotaging us from having the fun..

Currently on level 140 and I give up. They give orders that are impossible to fill without using diamonds to purchase difficult items, or buying energy. erasing half orders because of a "timeline", it is unfair, the least, especially when the item providers BARELY give the needed items for those orders, and the player spends tons of energy wrongfully. at least when you remove the timeline from the specific orders, let the player finish them and give a somewhat prize. in general, most orders are impossible to complete because of this. many reviews with the same or similar issues, you reply about fixing them for months. not. only getting worse.

I love the game, but it is impossible to report any bugs. it used to be very fun and nice, but now just about buying more and even that isn't enough to complete tasks .. the game is getting harder by each level which is ok but it becomes impossible to finish any task .. sometimes I need up to 3 days to finish one order. the orders and the items required is becoming ridiculous and difficult just to make you buy .. and I have bought a lot and spend a lot of money at the beginning and it was rewarding and fun But not anymore. the energy refill is terrible

Starts out fun. But after a while (somewhere around level 85 or 90), every quest is asking for an item that drops 1 time in 75 tries. It's a fun game, but needs some work. Why is the recharging taking longer each time? I shouldn't have to wait over 30 min ( not even 5 minutes) for my items to recharge. Was a nice game in the beginning when you didn't have to play 2-3 days before reaching small goals in the game. NOT as Advertised! After being flooded with ads with the "CEO", likely a down-on-luck actor, making claims about the game, I finally decided to try. Baffled by the review rating. Starts out fun as you can make progress easily. It becomes really boring as the upgrades are nearly impossible to earn even after they adjusted the mechanics to give you better hardware chests. I love this game. however some of the merges are too much with having to merge within a merge and then merge again like with the boom box merges. also I think you need to make it so players can opt to use the coins for building materials as there just isn't as many materials boxes offered to complete buildings the further you get into the game. for example out of the 5 orders I need to complete only 1 is offering a building materials box. and a way to earn more gems would be good too.

What I love most about this game is their random free energy, items. I even spent on a monthly basis bcoz I thk the game was really worth it. I am on level 289 and at this point it became almost impossible to restore buildings. Orders just give money, it takes ages to complete the necessary building materials. So.. I'm currently waiting on a new level (yes, I've completed all of them). I also purchase the 4.99 deal every two weeks. The first thing you all did wrong was split the energy. I originally downloaded this game based on an advertisement. It was nothing like the sorting advertisement, it is 100% a merge and match game. The game is enjoyable at first, but as the levels increase, the difficulty becomes nearly impossible. Energy takes too long to recharge, and even simple items require too many repeated actions. Right now, progressing without paying feels extremely hard and takes away the fun. The game has potential, but it needs serio

I've spent a lot of time and money in this game. Wish I could get this ad to stop playing. I have played this game and unless it changed tremendously then it's a lie. Completely misrepresented game. The ad you see for this game is nothing like the actual game. It's a merging game to sell items for coins. Initially fun to play and I really paid real money to play. As the level goes higher, buy 200 gems also cannot complete an order. I do enjoy the absent mindedness of playing. But buying a "super pass" that lasts less than 24 hours is an absolute ripoff. I've never heard of or seen that kind of "Super Pass" before. Doesn't seem very super to me. Definitely won't ever purchase anything again. Way too shady.

If you want to advance a whole bunch, this game will force you to use money in order to do so. Your energy level stays at 100, it never changes, especially when you level. It's a good game, but it asks too much for so little energy, at least give 1000 energy. I love this game and wish they can advance our energy levels as you level up... at least that's my opinion.

The game is just like Gossip Harbor You can play it for 20mins and run out of energy, then you have to wait 1 to 2hrs to gain full energy. This game just want money. Every requests and side quests are so difficult to clear, unless you pay to buy energy. The conclusion is : don't play this game unless you have a lot of money to spend, or you could wait for 3 hours to get the energy full to 100, and only take 3 minutes to spend. And wait again for 3 hours 😊

Several problems with this game: 1) I was promised $100 in free top-ups just for installing from an ad. Never happened. 2) this game takes WAY too much processing power, making it impossible to have my audio book playing while this game is running. 3) the ad I downloaded this game from (the same one that promised me $100 in free stuff) said that this game was exactly what the ad said it was. This is a blatant lie. It also said the game was ad-free, which is the only things that is true-ish.

I would've given this game 5 stars but for the fact that after playing for 2 weeks, it got so hard to fill orders that it was taking me days, just complete 1 or 2 orders. Absolute lie in the ads. I kept seeing ads for this game in other games, and it insisted that what you see in the ad is the game -- unlike others. It is not. There is no starving and cold woman with kid that you work to save. Don't be fooled like me by the ads that insist what you see in them is what you get. Uninstalling this sham of a game.

I will give this game a full 5-star review when the developers stop making fictitious ads. It's fun, or at least like, soothing, but once you get to a certain point you can play for about 3 minutes every 3hrs. It takes 3h to get 100 energy, 3 min to use it. As much as I appreciate the ease of getting coins in this game, it is RIDICULOUS how many appear with every merge, completely cluttering up the board. There are also way too many pop ups to purchase something and the characters are all kinda condescending to each other and I don't like the banter. Considering removing the game.

Super disappointed, it's just like any other story merge game - which is fine, but nothing like the ad which claims gameplay is /actually/ like the ad. I skipped ad bait so many times but I was really hoping this one was actually like it said with the home building choices with all the drama and genuinely free. Nope, tap to build- not even decor chioces JUST tap to build, run out of stamina after 5 minutes and unless you want to wait forever, guess what? You have to pay.

Nothing like the ads, unlike what they claim in the ad. In the ad they mention $100 worth of items by downloading from the ad's link, you don't get that. If you are here from an ad, do yourself a favor and save the data it takes to download it. This "game" is just mindless clicking that quickly leads you to microtransactions if you want to make any progress.

Used to be fun, now it's a disappointing money pit. Played multiple times/day for 6+ months. Spent way too much on upgrades and “specials” just to level up. They've changed the frequency for the toolboxes, and only seem to be offer 2 or 3 mini chests per 2nd tier/level 7 orders! It takes days just to complete 1 full set of each, so over a week to get enough for one building upgrade. I'm done.

Get ready to spend your money. The ONLY way to progress in the game is to merge, and that takes energy. Lots of it. Once you have used it up, you can trade in gems for more, or wait for your supply to refill. You can buy anything with in-app purchases, but it is easy to foresee that I will be spending lots of money to advance at a decent rate. I wish they at least had the option to watch an ad for more energy. I'm deleting the app!

you're essentially forced to either spend money or never progress because of how long it takes to create a single item. all 100 energy will be used and you still won't be able to create it, then you're stuck for days. genuinely the worst merge game I've played. I was also advertised $100 of in-game bonuses when I downloaded and never received anything so obviously this company is full of liars who falsely advertise just to get people to download.

It is a good game, history wise is interesting. My issue is that it is a pay to win game. If you dont buy energy or gems it will take an entire week just to complete one order, takes a lot of time to do it, specially with items that needs to be generated from other items. It's expensive, and we should have ads at least to gain more energy.

If you came here because they promised "Our game is exactly like the ads" well.. They lied! nothing about the ads is like the game. While Seaside Escape has beautiful visuals and a relaxing atmosphere, the gameplay quickly becomes frustrating. The pace is too slow for a casual game, and it feels more like a grind than a fun escape. Would be much better with a more balanced energy system.

I've been playing for less than a week and I'm at level 19. almost all of the orders require a top level item. The game needs to be balanced.

Very fun game but would love it if as you leveled up you gained more max energy. Nice storyline and great characters, but what should I do with 3,6 millions gold coins? I almost get no gems so I can't buy energy, and it takes days to fulfill one order. It takes the fun out of the game.

The game has too many cons. The merge items are super small while the cards are huge. The storyline is not cohesive. Depending one what you are building you are in another part of the story. I started out loving this game. This type of merging game always holds my interest. however, after reaching about level 150, maybe earlier even, it became so hard to finish even a single order. I would give it a 5 stars if you didn't remove the 1 whole day "Wishing On A Star" every other day feature and replaced it with a limited time of 1 hour every day only. runs out of energy too quickly. I have four merge games and this is the one I play the least. This game is no doubt so addictive and interesting. No ads at all. So simple and easy to understand. Loved this game so much. When you switch on the double mode energy option, 100 energies finish within 5 minutes. And when you max out a thing which produces other things, it should give big things.

I really enjoy this game BUT as many said after a while it becomes tedious when you have to merge rare items to get the top level so you can get a few items out of that to merge again... I used to love this game, but now I am just annoyed. Recently it has become impossible to complete orders with the energy given. Your energy depletes fast and does not reboot quick enough. I wish the game could be redesigned in a better way, because I want to leave a fair review on Google Play. Initially the game is fun and i like like many of the progression/game mechanics and events. Around lvl 33 it becomes a nightmare if you dont pay at all.
