More lies, just like gossip harbor. They have a couple ads that very clearly state there is a promotion currently going on, where if you download now using the link in the ad, you will get a welcome gift pack valued at $100. In reality, you get nothing, and their tech support just feeds you some nonsense about how you can accumulate $100 worth of prizes for free if you play long enough. Anyone else seeing this should report them to the Competition Bureau by using their online complaint form.

The game is beautiful. Great graphics and a wonderful story, but the downfall is the game itself. First it takes forever to complete a task, like way too long. Second the fact that you can't watch videos to get more energy is insane. Edit: the further I play the more ridiculous the game gets. Now I have to complete 6 steps to get even the smallest reward. The pay out for each task isn't worth it. and you need a ton of tools to upgrade anything but it's insanely hard to get said tools

This game is fun, but when there is an issue, customer support is less than helpful. I've had issues twice, and when I contacted to complain, the responses were more like, "Oh well, too bad for you." Glad I haven't spent real money on it... don't waste your breath. If you do have something go wrong after spending real money, I doubt they'll fix it. *Issues were with mini game allowing me to load item after time was up and wasting that peice and an energy box only giving me 44 energy total.

As stated by others, you can only play 3- 5 minutes. There's really no balance to the game. In the beginning, you have plenty (actually too much) to do and can progress in the game rather quickly. Now, not so much. It's an okay game, but it needs balance. I play other games by these developers, and I actually prefer those older games to this one.

I am level 58 so, needless to say, I've been playing for a while. I've just been so frustrated with the current events lately. Especially the Water Warrior event that was impossible to complete for me. Every level required bouquets of roses that can take 100+ energy to even have a chance at getting a single rose petal, let alone 4 needed within an hour. Wish they had checked the algorithm to see if the challenges were actually feasible for casual players.

There are no *external* ads, but everything in the game is an ad. It asks in 3 different popup menus every time you start the game to buy the season pack, newbie pack, extra special event pack. I have 40k gold, and it can be spent on nothing. Items in the store are ONLY purchased with rubies. Progress is locked behind *construction tools* which are random and sparse enough to encourage you to buy more. This game creates discontent to get you to buy your way out.

it's good enough. it's a fun enough merge game. i would say a fairly annoying downside, depending on the person, is how difficult it is to actually progress the story because of the requirements for building being so hyper specific. without tools, it doesn't matter how much money you have, so the game can stagnate.

Unfortunately made a choice to uninstall the app as it's increasingly frustrating to play. I was on a 160+ level, and it's practically impossible to play, unless you want to spend real money of course. 100 energy sometimes wasn't enough to get even a part of what you need. It was only possible to play once per three-four days during bingo and train events, which gave you the chests. Would put 0 stars if I could, but leaving 1 just because it used to be enjoyable at the start.

Installed the game for only two reasons. First, to complain about the misleading, and very long, and very annoying ads I keep being forced to watch while playing games I actually want to play. And second, I installed it, opened it, and uninstalled it, and now Google won't show me your ANNOYING AD FULL OF LIES ANYMORE! At least for a while. I'll enjoy not seeing your face for a long as possible.

I have played a lot of these merging games and this is definitely the best one by far. There's a lot of fun little events, the orders are challenging but it doesn't take days to complete and leveling goes pretty fast. There's still room for improvement, for example I wouldn't mind watching an ad for extra energy or maybe starting the daily energy cost at 10 instead of 20!

really fun interesting storyline in the game is fun. best of all no ads. I feel the stories are kind of scattered due to it making us jump around buildings instead of going thru the story linearly like Gossip harbor. as your level gets higher you get disproportionately more coins than building material. so you are left with w bunch of coins you cannot use. they keep asking for orders that's not on the board or hard to fill as well which made the game a chore later on so I stopped playing.

This game was initially very fun and interesting to play, but it quickly becomes almost impossible to complete orders. The amount of energy is low and takes too long to regenerate. The lowest items are most frequently dispensed, making it super difficult to actually get the items needed to fulfill orders. It can sometimes take days to fulfill an order, which is highly annoying. I would not recommend this game to persons looking to just have fun and not have to spend a ton of money to do so.

Gets costly to play after a while. It starts off good, but as you progress, it becomes difficult to play, and then you have to pay... and pay... and pay some more. Some items are difficult to get - others are quick to entice you to keep playing. I now play only the 100 coins I get, and that is it. Another thing that is a little annoying is all the sublime and the barrage of pop-ups. That can be a little frustrating as I really do not want to play those games sometimes.

Money grab game. The game is designed to make you spend lots of money. As you advance the randomness seems to be against you to make certain merge items. You can go through 200 energy over and over. If you had some say or impact on what generated it would be more interesting. It is all to chance with no strategy or logic therefore it is just about raising frustration level until you have enough that you spend money to get one small thing. No skill so it is not a game.

At first it was fun to play, but when you start to level up, it gets more and more boring and annoying. Eventho you have 500 energy bolts, but you cant even complete one order. Somehow this game will tricks you to buy more gems or energy bolts. Its ridiculous and a waste of time. I spent hundreds real money to buy gems, but cant complete even one order. Such a scam game, now i decided to delete this game app. Waste of time and money!!

I really like the game, low-key cozy gameplay and nice art style. The only problem I have right now is it's too expensive, very expensive I could say as a person who uses Thai baht. The minimum price for this game is 71-73 THB, which is more expensive than my one meal 😭 If you could lower the price, the people would pay you more. Said by a person who paid your game for a thousand baht... Edit: as I read all the complaints, no you never updated anything, quite disappointed.

Great game but I really hate how you push your offers in my face whenever I open the app. I mean, I'm just trying to play the game but I have to first view so many offers, when I'm not trying to purchase anything, before I can play. EDIT: Why do I have to spend so much energy to get the items I need?? For example, the For sale sign and School supplies. You spend so much energy but they keep bringing out anything but the items you need to merge.

I'm changing my review because the game is getting worse with each update. I'm going to delete it soon! u guys are making the tasks so hard to complete it's taking days! it's just a game for fun, if a player stopped having fun and only did tasks to finish it won't be necessary to play anymore. Please, fix that ! and we used to have every day a bonus for 3 hours now it's 1 hour where we can't do anything! if it is a way to get more money I'm honestly speaking you will lose your players thank u

Game itself not bad, no ads either (don't count about pop-up ads of their own packages, those always there in any game), cute design. Sadly, 100 energy too short (20 gems to buy 100 energy extra), only need 5 mins and nothing else I could do. No ads for extra energy, just 100 or 200 free at the beginning. Can't pick decorations either, all automatically upgrades when we have enough resources.

this game used to be fun and relaxing. Over time, it becomes way to difficult to advance without spending money. I have spent money to play longer, and that became an issue. Due to the fact I wouldn't be able to advance after a period of time, like initially. I quit spending and now I am taking baby step to complete orders....like days. I'll end up deleting soon

The game is fun and actually keeps you interested n the no ads is true. however earning enough gems or energy is so tedious and if you don't spend actual money It can take days to finish a single order, if you want to play for free. Again can my problem is that can the generators be made in a way that if it is upgraded the items too are upgraded to the higher instead of still being at the first level.

Fun way to kill time -for a little while. Energy is used up so quickly and takes so long to gain back. Bundles and extra energy is overpriced and not worth it. It can take all day+a few days to fill even a single order and space gets taken up by event items that also take forever to spawn. Ultimately the way the game is set up is meant to make you spend money. Doubtful this game will become more accessible over time.

This game is great, fun, addictive, lots of different bits and bobs to do, BUT you don't really get to enjoy it unless you put money in to it. Otherwise your 'energy' runs out in about 1 minute. So you end up putting money in just to keep playing, then when you've got a balance of energy or gems, everything costs more so it erodes your stash. So I would.give it 5 stars for fun, and had to give it 3 because it's really a pay to play game.

So, in the recent event, when you have to gather photos by completing orders during the last 13 days of the event, every time I finish an order, the photos I need stop showing up. This event and game are a huge scam. All I had left was 1 photo and to get the photo I needed they wanted me to spend $19.99 on a bundle pack I'm uninstalling forget that. I can keep my money in my pocket.

I hate the ads for the game. If he is the "alleged" owner and creator of the game he needs to grow up and mature his ads, not act like a spoilt brat chucking a tantrum. I've had this game for years; years before the in-bonus short games became popular. It's not about free, it's about lying, it's about false advertising. I have NOT yet come across one of those short bonus games. I believe I'm going to have to reach a particular level before I do. So change your ads to meet the reality of the game

Don't download this game. First of all the adds are misleading. Its a merge game- not a puzzle game. Secondly, doesnt matter how much time, effort and money you put into this game you aren't guaranteed to finish certain side quests. Its a money pit and a scam. Customer service useless as well. Best to just stay away and find another game to play.

It's fun and i enjoy it, but unlike their other games, the tasks vs max items seem unbalanced. Max item luggage yields such low items that it takes weeks to complete orders. And the orders at a point are only high orders instead of being a good mix like their other games. I want to keep playing, but this imbalance makes it more boring later on and hard to keep going and coming back to.

I started out loving this game. Now, it sucks!!! I've made to level 400 something and it's like you're just stuck. Doesn't give you the chance to complete orders to progress in the game. Don't play this game!!!!! It turns out to be nothing but disappointment. Oh, and when you reach out to customer service, you get the stupid robot that only says "sorry, we will relay the message" or some bs like that.

this game could be fun. and is for a bit after you spend a lot of money. With 100 max earned energy, you hit a pay wall within literal minutes. spend a ton of money and still need to spend over 2000 energy(bout $20 worth) to get one single item. Still haven't gotten it and its been well over 2000. Reached out to customer service and couldn't get past a bot. They wouldn't even let me talk to a person. I have spent around $500 on this game. biggest rip off. response is a bot even, devs do not care

Honestly it's a good concept of a game it is, the story is engaging and really makes me want to save the island, which is why two stars instead of one. However the boards too small &the RNG (Random Number Generator) for things that produce multiple items to be merged is way too imbalanced. If I need a level 5 eye bracelet and I'm spending 80 out of 100 energy just to get a level 1 eye bracelet, it feels like a waste of time. Same with the scrubs from the baths, and lemons from the cutting board

I really want to like this game. There is so much going on at one time. Orders cannot be filled because it getting the item seems unattainable. And before you know it, there is a new item on the board to use energy and space for something I really need. I cannot clear and use the whole board due to an item not available until level 8. Honestly, too many irons in the fire. Yet, I like the music and the overall play. And enjoy the rewards.

I really like this game but I'm probably going to stop playing soon and uninstall. The game started out fun and the system seemed to reward you accordingly. But with time all the orders need large amounts of energy to be completed and the game rarely gives you the pieces that you need to complete orders. It's frustrating, I finish very little orders in a week bc the game doesn't produce the pieces I need instead it gives me pieces that don't have active orders.

First, I want to say how much I enjoy your game,every detail feels so thoughtfully crafted. However, I’m running into a real roadblock with the music box collection: The microphone, which is supposed to produce music boxes, almost never drops them. The choice boxes don’t yield any music boxes at all. I’ve spent every gem I have buying music boxes. It’s getting frustrating enough that I’m considering moving on from the game. Could you please look into adjusting the drop rates?

I've been playing this game for less than a week; the wait time for energy is highly offensive as almost every idle phone game, to include this one, is CONSTANTLY wanting money. There's no point in playing to kill time when 100 taps in and you're done for the day unless you want to give this app money, over and over, and over again. Did I mention the goal of this game is to get money from you?

Sad to say "the boss of seaside escape" let me down today. I was inundated with ads for this game on another game I play and finally, after being told to trust "the boss" 1000 times, I did. Sadly, the story line is nothing as advertised. However, they were true to their word that the game has no ads which is refreshing. I played for a while but I was pretty upset at having been bamboozled by the ads for the game so I have uninstalled it.

This is by far the best merge story game I have found thus far. The merge mechanics are very smooth and there are LOADS of items to discover. Plus, there is a library of all the items you have discovered, and you are rewarded for each new item. The story is incredibly engaging and relatively easy to follow. Lots of unique and lovable characters with various side plots to support the main plot. I find it fairly easy to gain energy without spending any money. Def reccomend!

Enjoyed the game, but I'm deleting it. It never lets you finish tasks. You blow through energy because the generator never gives you what you need.. I don't like the double item generator, and I don't like the double speed. It should give you advanced pieces every now and then. Never get a break, never get a freebie like other games. I would keep playing. it's not fun anymore. You don't give us enough time to complete challenges, and I play daily

One of the best merge format games—but after a while it gets hard to pick up, as that 100 energy points gets less and less helpful throughout the game, making each time I open the app a frustrating 3 minutes of barely making a dent in a single order and then I run out. Buy this if you're cool only checking in for a couple minutes a day! But I've found that most other merge games give you more assistance in playing for a longer time.

Started out great but they changed the bellhop trolley so it's eating up all your spins. Five taps to get it to produce, then five more to get that to produce if it even gives you what you need in the first place. They got greedy, unfortunately. It will take you a minimum of 3-4 games @ 100 spins to get what you need unless you buy gems which is obviously what they are trying to get you to do. So yeah, it's fun up until you get to that level, then no more.

Unless you want to spend money, sometimes all you're going to be able to do is play for about 6 minutes, until your "energy" is gone. So is it truly Free To Play? In addition, the "events" are one right on top of the other, to the point that one "event" blocked me from doing what I needed to do in the other "event." And it's really obnoxious how they force you to click on and view an offer related to an "event", when you are not spending any money on the game since it's not in the budget!

Lots of great possibilities, but not put together in a thorough way. You can merge a ton of things. This part is great and interesting, but also difficult to get to work for the game flow and it doesn't work well in this game. You keep getting new mini-challenges on top of the basic ones, with harsh time frame for solving. It seems there isn't a good way to play the game unless you invest a lot of money in it or doesn't care if tasks are solved. They should have kept it simpler.

It's a fun game with great graphics. It' difficult when the only way to get the toolboxes is to complete the big orders which take so much energy. It's unfortunate that the only way to get more energies is to wait for 3 hours for energy to be refilled. There's not even an option to watch ads for like 15 energy, just to have the chance of getting the one item I need to finish an order. And it's ridiculous that the flower vase takes 6 energy to give 1 low-level item. Disappointing and frustrating.

What a waste of great graphics and a storyline! Nearly all the orders are high-level, so there's no sense of accomplishment when you have to spend your energy bar on 1-2 orders, then start all over again later. Additionally, just came back and got forced into at least 12 screens in which I did not get to play at all, no sign of letting up. Why make a game people can't play? Too much forced input for optional side effects is poor design. Shame, it's almost a fun game!

This is a really good game actually until they pushed so many stuff on the board. As soon as I started the game I felt stressed as too many different items displayed and almost all quests required high level items. I lost the enjoyment playing this game. Hopefully the developer can find another way to push users to buy something from them, understand that they also need to profit but they need to crack how users will spend their money for more enjoyment rather than making them anxious.

Your ads are terrible. The guy with the red hair screaming all the time. It irritates you so bad that the last game on earth anyone would ever play is seaside escape. Just because the ads alone are horrific. Everytime i hear the name of this game. I am instantly drawn to immediately try to get it off my screen. Not even worth a star!!!!!!!! Take your terrible ads off.

I like the characters and story, but there needs to be some serious balancing of resources. You end up with a lot of spawners and not very much energy and a lot of the orders later on don't give any coins but instead building supplies or some other stuff. I think it would be much better if it just stuck to coins or at least give coins plus another item for orders. The lack of coins really messes with the enjoyment of the game because you just get stuck eventually

it's a solid game at first. But, eventually, with the cost of energy and the items that drop 1 out of every 50 clicks, you spend more time closing the obnoxious event pop-ups when you try to play than actually playing. There are days I might get to play the game 5-6 minutes because energy is depleted. It makes get used to just not playing all together. They either need to increase energy or tinker with the drop rates.

It's a decent game when you are starting out, but then it becomes VERY clear in order to play more than 2 min you have to pay to get more energy. The higher you level the more energy it takes to fill an order, but nothing changes to help get you more energy. The refill is 1 energy every 2 min, which is fine on the lower levels, but as the orders get harder to fill you spend 1-2 min playing your full 100 energy bar to NOT fill an order then wait 3 hrs to fill up & repeat...gen takes 800 energy

fulfilling orders is impossible to do unless you pay for gems or energy. coins are useless. I have excess coins but cannot do anything with them. building materials are scarce in game. why not let players buy some boxes and energy with coins even if at inflated prices? the best thing about this game is story, not sure it is enough to make me continue to play. Edit: I hate to say that it only seems to get worse. The standard 100 energy does very little. random drops are never the thing you need!

I downloaded this game after seeing an ad which portrayed the game as the image marked "Come and play." I have yet to see any content similar to this in the game. Progression is slow after the first levels -- there are too many special events, and it's hard to find orders that actually are for coins to progress the storyline. Not a fan.

It's not what's advertised. It's just another typical merge game. If you like merge games, you'll like it. The graphics are done well. If you don't like merge games, don't bother. I just wish, for once, there was actually a game that had all the levels and functions that are shown in their ads. I would give more stars if they hadn't falsely advertised their game.

Its a good game but the amount of money needed to be spent for a short period of play is ridiculous. You could buy the latest playstation and a game and get more play out of it than you would with this game. Then the more you spend, the more you have to spend to keep playing as the levels increase. You can play slightly longer than gossip harbour, but its not much better

The game is so relaxing and addictive but I have some problems with it. I think there should be an option to increase the energy level like we buy slots in the storage room. instead for the energy to stop counting at 100 it can be increased and i also noticed that the items that produces more than 1 items do not produce the one you need on time it's always the one you doesn't need it produces and it's tiring waiting a whole 3 hrs for energy and it can't even be useful

Hello, happy new year. Why does the game have to reload and waste my time each time I minimize the app to go do something else, even if it's for a few seconds? Please fix this. And, you make it impossible to complete Rowan's scrapbook. I had found 92/108 cards and still couldn't complete the scrapbook in 13 whole days?? That's just crazy. Kindly remove that completely because there's no point trying.

The game was really fun. I was enjoying myself and upgrading buildings where fun until you have to have tools to be able to upgrade, which is rare to get I now have 23238 coins and can't upgrade like I said tools are very rare to get then you have a item that needs made but that item takes 6 taps to get the items you need. So, just saying don't waste your time unless you just want to merge items and deliver them and earn coins because that's all you can do.

Saw this game in many an ad saying that if I downloaded from the link in the video, I would receive $100 worth of free gifts. No such luck! The ad also stated there are no ads in the game. That one is true. Been playing for a week now and not an ad in sight. That being said, its a standard merge game that's not too difficult to play. Requires a lot of patience as the items needed to fulfill orders requires merging many, many, many times. All in all, not a bad game to pass the time.

This game just sucks. Everything is designed in a way to siphon the money out of your pocket. Most stuff wants to max a product which devolves after using it a little. Energy takes too long to refill. Oh I forgot about the items you have to create to continue the game. Those can take litteral days to finish. Until you finish that item you cant even progress. Dont play it.

I love this game but I feel like you don't get enough of the pieces you need. I clicked the desk every couple hours for 3 days and I never got one paintbrush or paint item, just viles. They need to up how often to get certain items Need longer time in the mini missions. I can get to the last step or two but then it ends. Add a day to all of them.

This was a nice game,with great graphics. I really wanted to play it to the end,but the game became like a chore, and I didn't look forward to playing it. There isn't enough energy,as the level goes up (I am level 34). Some resource pieces drain them like water. Ex., the Pots. You have to use 6 energies to get a piece,and that piece isn't guaranteed to be the one you are looking for. Also,the decoration of the place is decided for you,there aren't any options. Also, you have to pay to advance.

I honestly like this game. I have some complaints, but nothing too serious. The reason for my rating is the ad I saw today. While playing a different game, I saw an ad for Seaside Escape that calls it a Mahjong game. The gameplay shown in the ad is all fake! This is very much a merging game, and a decently fun one at that. I have no idea why the developers would create an ad that lies about the nature of their game. It's a good game on its own, and there's no reason to deceive anyone.

If you came to download this game because of the constant ads with someone claiming to be the "head of the game company" promising that, unlike all the other ads that show a woman and a child trying to survive but then the game is nothing like that, HIS game IS like that, well, guess what... that's a lie. The game is a merge game like 100 others where you rebuild a Greek-style seaside resort that is decaying. No finally fixing the window so the woman and child in the ad won't starve.

The ads are an absolute lie. They have the littlest detail true to game so that they can't get sued but even worse is that a guy from the ad said I'll get 100 energy, 100 coins and 100 gems for free if I download the game from the ad link. I did exactly that and got nothing! They are lying to get more players. Don't waste your time please.

It is a good game, but the reason for the one star is that it soon becomes very tiresome when the merged items you need are so complicated that it takes days worth of energy just to make one item. Some of the items you need are also just chance whether they will appear or not so your board soon becomes full with other items while you are still trying gor the one item you need. The game becomes very boring

The game isn't bad but besides the main character, nothing as described or shown in the ad I downloaded it from!! Goal is supposed to be saving a mom and her child and it's not. Plus, promised $100 worth of free stuff for the game if I downloaded from the link in the ad but haven't seen that either. Disappointed for sure!

I just started this merge game. So far so good.....there are 🚫 ads, a fun merge game with a storyline and incentives. You don't have to buy coins or packages to go up in the ranks of the game, it is optional. I only gave a four star because I'm just starting. I did read the other reviews and basically said the same until you get further up in the game. If you're willing to spend the money, go for it, if not don't.

Some issues I have are the fact that most of the pictures shown here don't match what the game looks like. You don't get to personally decorate or even see inside the buildings, there's no plot even close to the 2nd pic, and it's a merging game so the 1st pic is heavily inaccurate. The game is a little money hungry but is survivable and still enjoyable if you're f2p. The storyline is interesting, it's got a slow burn, and lgbtq representation. I really love it, would rate 5 stars but the pics..

Ive been playing this game practically since launch and I'm frustrated with the latest updates. I logged in tonight and suddenly the prize path was shut down, a few days early. I paid the $4.99 for both prize tiers, so Im pretty upset. Additionally, it seems like energy takes forever to regenerate. Ill walk away for a couple hours and return to a half full gauge, which goes far too fast. Im genuinely considering uninstalling this game if these issues persist.

The game is interesting and fun. However, yes, you don't need to spend money to play the game if you are only going to play for a little while a day. On the flipside you are going to have to spend money if you want to play it continuously. I would rather if they put ads in it to get lightning bolt. So far the game isn't like that ads and Google should start flagging games who mislead people.

I enjoyed it a lot at first and the storyline is nice, I didn't even mind spending money on the monthly pass(4.99)......but now the monthly pass is 2 weeks instead of once a month(at the same price). It's not worth buying because the 2 weeks are up before you can even collect everything and energy takes TOO LONG to regenerate and each order takes at least 2 days to complete. Buying energy chests as well is too expensive. Game isn't fun anymore. Wouldn't recommend it to anyone. Fixthemonthlypass!

Pretty good so far, just started playing and it isn't difficult to earn coins. The only annoying part of the game is getting earring parts from the suit case. It took 300 energy including the free energy they gave you to get up to the sapphire earrings. And you can't progress until you do, I just dislike how stupidly hard it is to get something that shouldn't be so difficult to spawn. So maybe fix the spawn rate on earrings it really annoys me.

It was fun, and very easy to complete orders at first. But after a certain point it became way too frustrating; small number of orders, and the generator seems to drop items that I don't need WAY more than the ones I DO need. It feels like the game doesn't want me to play at all. And the orders now don't even include items from previous generators anymore, making them useless and just taking up space in the board.

Game doesn't match pictures at all... Not sure if I need to progress further or something, but I wanted to play that game that used majong tiles, but all I have is some weird merge game and nothing else. Super big waste of time. I guess it's fun and functional for what it is, but the false advertising is the reason I'm rating so low... Seriously the game would do better if it actually showed pictures from the actual game rather then advertising a bunch of mini games that don't seem to be in it.

First, I want to say the game at the surface is good and perfect for its quick gameplay. Second, the facts about the game in-depth, it has become unprogressive for me at Lv. 52, when the orders are now ridiculously high which are both RARE and LAYERED pops—taking a lot of energy and wasting a lot of time generating, this also affects the fairness in terms of contest with other players being unfavorable. Last, the decorative event I avoided to keep my fave set didn't work. All those grind wasted.

You can exactly see and feel the moment when developers gave up on the game. It is fun at first, until you get to the "olive" phase. Suddenly you need 6 energy to get a basic item. All orders require such items, you finish one, identical order appears and you can start from scratch. Takes literally days to finish any order. "How to screw up a game for everyone and get as much money as possible for no effort" solution. It's a pity because I enjoyed it at first.

I used to play this game too until it got so annoying in completing orders and getting enough energy. You literally have to spend money(lots of them) to clear the levels. Same issue with the othet games. Generators suck even if you have high lvls of them. Levels and goals are impossible. Energy is too slow.

So tell me, which game is it? Seaside escape or gossip harbor? Looks like both games are made by the same company, don't reuse ads. It looks really bad when you dumped over another game name over a hey I'm the boss of so-and-so game. Basically install this game just to rate it one-star. Getting tired of all these claims from game makers oh look no ads you don't have to spend any money. And guess what? There are tons of ads. You get to a point where unless you do spend money you'll never get any
